department: Department of Civil, Environmental and Geomatic Engineering

deadline.value: Applications for research degrees are accepted on a rolling basis; UCL recommends applying at least four months before the intended start date.
deadline.quote: If your course has no application deadline, we recommend you apply at least four months before your intended start date.

entry_route.value: Research applicants are normally required to hold either a first or upper-second class bachelor's degree from a UK university or a recognised taught master's degree (or overseas equivalent).
entry_route.quote: research applicants will normally be required to hold a first or upper-second class Bachelor...degree from a UK university...in an appropriate subject, or a recognised taught Master...degree. Overseas qualifications of an equivalent standard from a recognised higher education institution are also accepted.

supervisor.value: Applicants must contact the academic department to discuss suitability and ensure a suitable supervisor is available before applying.
supervisor.quote: Please note - Before you apply, contact the academic department to discuss your suitability and to ensure a suitable supervisor is available.

funding.value: Academics can help identify funding sources and nominate qualified candidates for scholarships.
funding.quote: They can also nominate you for scholarships.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Civil, Environmental and Geomatic Engineering MPhil/PhD at University College London.
